title: Universal first order thickenings and conormal sheaves under flat base change
statement: Let $h':W\to Y$ be a formally unramified morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism], $g:X\to Y$ a flat morphism [def-weil-flat-morphism], and $Z=X\times_YW$ the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $h:Z\to X$ and $f:Z\to W$. Let $W\subset W'$ be a universal first order thickening of $W$ over $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening], with closed immersion $i_W:W\to W'$ and structure morphism $W'\to Y$. Then: (1) $h$ is formally unramified; (2) the morphism $i_Z:=\mathrm{id}_X\times i_W:Z=X\times_YW\to Z':=X\times_YW'$ makes $Z\subset Z'$, with the projection $Z'\to X$, a universal first order thickening of $Z$ over $X$; (3) with $f':Z'\to W'$ the projection, so that $f'\circ i_Z=i_W\circ f$, the morphism $f'$ is flat and the canonical map $f^*\mathcal C_{W/Y}\to\mathcal C_{Z/X}$ of conormal sheaves [def-weil-pbc-conormal-sheaf-formally-unramified], [def-pc-module-pullback], induced by $f'^\sharp$ (which maps $f'^{-1}$ of the ideal sheaf of $i_W$ into the ideal sheaf of $i_Z$, Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 01R4), is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 04F8 (lemma-universal-thickening-fibre-product) and Lemma 04F9 (lemma-universal-thickening-fibre-product-flat); the conormal map is Morphisms, Lemma 01R4 (lemma-conormal-functorial), its bijectivity Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (lemma-conormal-functorial-flat)
